rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's thirteen builder trees go (canary date palms, corals and ficus along the back fences, a queen and a fan palm 3.6-3.9 m from the houses, jacarandas by the chairs); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by two adirondack chairs, on the open lot corner, and two back yards.
